title: The reduction of a scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Its *nilradical* $\mathcal N_X\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ is the quasi-coherent ideal sheaf whose sections over an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R$ are the nilradical of $R$ (the ideal of nilpotent elements). The *reduction* of $X$ is the closed subscheme $X_{\mathrm{red}}$ of $X$ cut out by $\mathcal N_X$, i.e. the ringed space $(X,\mathcal O_X/\mathcal N_X)$, together with its canonical closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] $i_X:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$, which is the identity on underlying sets.
